Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 kword VARCHAR2(300);
 statment VARCHAR2(100);
 ch VARCHAR2(1);
 V_DESC VARCHAR2 (1000);
 
 BEGIN
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 V_DESC := :GLOBAL.SYS_ANAME ;
 ch := '';
 kword := '';
 statment := :CALLING_PARAMETERS.P_FROM; 
 FOR i IN 1..length(:P_FROM)+1
 LOOP
 ch := SUBSTR(statment,i,1);
 
 IF ch != ',' THEN
 kword := kword|| ch;
 
 ELSE
 IF KWORD IS NOT NULL THEN 
 :CTR_BLK.P_SYSOBJ_ID := kword ;
 
 CREATE_RECORD ;
 kword := '';
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 
 
 END LOOP;
 
EXCEPTION
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
NULL;
WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :CTR_BLK.P_SYSOBJ_ID := :GLOBAL.P_SYSOBJ_ID ; 
END ;

------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE
 V_kword VARCHAR2(3000);
 V_statment VARCHAR2(1000);
 V_ch VARCHAR2(1);
 V_DESC VARCHAR2 (1000);
 
BEGIN
 
 V_DESC := :GLOBAL.SYS_ANAME ;
 
 V_ch := '';
 V_kword := '';
 V_statment := V_DESC; 
 FIRST_RECORD ;
 FOR i IN 1..length( V_DESC)+1
 LOOP
 V_ch := SUBSTR(V_statment,i,1);

 ELSE

EXCEPTION

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 ch VARCHAR2(1);
 kword VARCHAR2(300);
 RET NUMBER;
 statment VARCHAR2(100);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count number(5); 
 V_TEMP NUMBER (5);
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);
 BEGIN 
V_COUNT := 0;
statment := :CALLING_PARAMETERS.P_FROM; 
IF STATMENT IS NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(AS_1.SYSOBJ_ID)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM
 SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS L_SYSOBJ,
 ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS AS_1
 WHERE
 AS_1.SYSOBJ_ID = L_SYSOBJ.SYSOBJ_ID;
 ELSE
 
 FOR i IN 1..length(:P_FROM)+1
 LOOP
 ch := SUBSTR(statment,i,1);
 IF ch != ',' THEN
 kword := kword|| ch;
 
 ELSE
 IF (KWORD IS NOT NULL) THEN 
 SELECT count(AS_1.SYSOBJ_ID)
 into V_TEMP
 FROM
 SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS L_SYSOBJ,
 ACTIVITY_SUBJECTS AS_1
 WHERE
 (AS_1.SYSOBJ_ID = L_SYSOBJ.SYSOBJ_ID)
 AND L_SYSOBJ.SYSOBJ_ID IS NOT NULL AND L_SYSOBJ.SYSOBJ_ID IN (KWORD) ;
 kword := '';
 V_COUNT := V_COUNT + V_TEMP;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 
 IF :P_FROM IS NULL THEN
 :parameter.SELECT_STR := ' AND SYSOBJ_ID IS NOT NULL' ;
 ELSE
 :parameter.SELECT_STR := ' AND SYSOBJ_ID in ( '||:P_FROM||')' ; 
 
 END IF; 
 if v_count > 0 then

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 MESSAGE(:parameter.V_ORDER);
 MESSAGE(:parameter.V_ORDER);
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REP_TITLE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SCREEN_NAME); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'SELECT_STR',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.SELECT_STR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 rep.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;



END;
END;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PA_FROM',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_FROM);
